cohort: 207 births in women with early-onset colorectal cancer (ages 18-49) and 1019 births in women without colorectal cancer in Sweden (1992-2019)
finding: Maternal history of early-onset colorectal cancer was associated with an increased risk of pre-eclampsia, cesarean delivery (particularly emergency), and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Women with early-onset colorectal cancer had an increased odds of any cesarean section (OR = 1.43, 95%CI = 1.00-2.06), particularly emergency C-section (OR = 1.79, 95%CI = 1.17-2.75).
